label: Bible Study
prompt: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy _____.
verse: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
note: The verse right after 'Trust in the LORD' — acknowledge him, and he handles the map.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD make his face _____ upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verse: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
note: The priestly blessing: God's face turned toward you like sunrise. That's the whole gift.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your _____ will find you out.
verse: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
note: One of the most-quoted warnings in Scripture: your sin isn't lost, it's out looking for you.

label: Deep Water
prompt: As the _____ panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
verse: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
note: A hart is a deer, not a 'heart' — though the psalmist means both kinds of thirst.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For what shall it _____ a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
verse: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
note: The KJV frames the soul as a ledger entry: what shall it 'profit' a man? Bad trade, says Jesus.
